title: Ad-Waste & AI Conversion Leak Auditor Input

domains.title: Target Store / Business Domains
domains.description: List of store or company domains to audit (e.g. ['gymshark.com', 'glossier.com']). Automatically normalizes URLs.

checkAiShoppingReadiness.title: Audit 2026 AI Shopping Agent Readiness (GEO)
checkAiShoppingReadiness.description: Checks /llms.txt availability, robots.txt AI crawler rules (OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot), and Product/Offer JSON-LD schema completeness.

checkConversionAndTechLeaks.title: Audit Checkout Friction & Missing Ad Pixels
checkConversionAndTechLeaks.description: Detects e-commerce platform (Shopify, WooCommerce, etc.) and checks for missing retention/remarketing pixels (Klaviyo, Meta CAPI, TikTok Pixel, GA4).

checkContactsAndHiring.title: Extract Decision-Maker Contacts & Hiring Signals
checkContactsAndHiring.description: Extracts public decision-maker emails, social links, DNS mail records, and checks for open marketing/growth job postings.

workspaceStateKey.title: Delta State Tracking Key (Optional for Daily Cron)
workspaceStateKey.description: Optional identifier to track changes between runs (emits NEW_LEAK_DETECTED or TECH_STACK_CHANGED).
